title: Neutral late-year scenario versus central all-modeled revenue loss

claims.text: A direct comparison against the neutral late-year scenario cannot be completed: the fixed evidence packet contains no numeric cell or scalar parameter value for that scenario (scenario parameters were excluded from this packet), and no adaptive retrieval or recomputation is available. Only the central all-modeled aggregate mean for the second projected year is reported above. Any relative difference between the neutral late-year scenario and the central value would be an unsupported recomputation and is not asserted.

limitations: The neutral late-year scenario value is absent from the fixed evidence packet (scenario parameters not included as scalar parameter evidence), so the requested comparison cannot be quantified.

The all-modeled aggregate mean is a signed mean loss estimate (positive = neutral revenue minus event revenue); it is not a tail measure and should not be confused with the positive-part shortfall used for VaR or ES.
Estimates are conditional on the stated macroeconomic path and the stated forecast vintage; models are not causally identified and historical input provenance is incomplete (inspection only).

Values reflect only the twelve modeled economies covering agriculture, forestry and fishing value added and conditional government revenue transmission; this is not a total-economy loss nor a sovereign default probability.
